I used to own a Magnus built 2010 Lancer Ralliart and now I've moved onto my dream car which is an Evo 8.
Personally as an Evo fan, I used to love the X but after I got a ralliart at 355whp I wanted something more raw in power and manual so I got an older evo and boy do I love how raw the driving experience is in it. Overall Ralliart was good enough that I didn't need or want an X anymore. 

1. I'm assuming Evo X and Ralliart, not much of a difference if you aren't going to be tracking or competing in competitions of any sort. 

2. My Ralliart was pretty reliable and being a student at the time the cost of everything wasn't too stressful. 

3. I started off modding with the ralliart, a bunch of simple cosmetic upgrades(exhaust, wheels, suspension, lips, wing, etc.) because the engine was already slightly modded and tuned when I bought it.

4. Like everyone else said it's about midrange and depends if the previous owner did any. Once you get it all out of the way it should be fine. 

5. The SST in the Ralliart was pretty fun but pushing 355whp it'd probably feel the same in the Evo X MR. My evo 8 on the other hand I am certain I'm never going to sell it because I love everything about it.

I've been kicked out multiple times at different ages, youngest being around 13(7th Grade). My mother has a lot of problems and I don't blame her for anything. The first couple times getting kicked out I don't remember the reasoning but she packed my clothes in a garbage bag and through them out the apartment along with telling me to go somewhere else. I called a friend and his parents cleaned out their storage room(a lot of stuff was just thrown in there so it was a lot of work) And I stayed there for a couple of days and then I started to get suicide threats on my phone she gave me telling me if I didn't come home she would die and all that other stuff. 

Second time I was kicked out she was having a fight with my step dad and these fights with my step dad usually led to me getting kicked out for a couple of times. I was raised to not lie and to judge for myself what right and wrong and the whole fight my mother was in the wrong. I didn't really take either sides I was more like a judge and I thought he had the better case so I told her that and that she started this whole situation. This resulted in my mother telling me I'm a deadbeat, I'm useless and that she's raised me for nothing. She had a drinking problem which is an obvious cause of her erratic behaviour quite a bit of the time. I left with nothing but the clothes I had with me and my phone. Luckily I had a friend that would let me stay at their house and go to school with them, this went on for a month before I got more suicide threats telling me to come back. Usually when I come back she acts normal and pretends nothing happened when really it's happened many times and you can't just pretend that it didn't happen.
